channel.title: Pier & Point · 1500 Owens Street
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for 1500 Owens Street (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · 1500 Owens Street: The 1500 Owens page now describes the building as a six-story office/lab/retail building, as its building permit does; the architect describes the project as an outpatient clinical facility with a surgery center, radiology suite and academic offices. City parcel records show the permit's lot retired and the current lot created on the same date, 2009-04-08; whether that was a one-to-one renumbering or a split is not stated.

item.title: Correction · 1500 Owens Street: The record's summary and map notes listed Sports Medicine, Physical Therapy & Rehabilitation, and other clinics at 1500 Owens; the cited UCSF Health page confirms only Radiology (Musculoskeletal Imaging), so the summary now names the Orthopaedic Institute and Radiology and the map notes carry a dated correction. The map caveat and notes said the construction date was not confirmed; the record's own DBI permit (filed 2006, completed 2009-07-31) and the Assessor's 2009 year built confirm it, and only the architect remains unconfirmed. 'Mission Bay South' now cites the OCII land use map. The Wikimedia aerial's credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural. The October 1, 2009 opening rests on a UCSF news page that blocks automated fetches and is listed among the record's open questions.

item.title: Complete · 1500 Owens Street: UCSF Orthopaedic Institute building at 1500 Owens St completed (the architect Nacht & Lewis gives 2009 as the completion year; DBI permit 200611298694 is recorded complete on July 31, 2009). A UCSF news release is cited for the institute's opening on October 1, 2009 as UCSF's first clinical service at Mission Bay; that page returned HTTP 403 and could not be read, so the day is unconfirmed (~2009)
